rule.name: SharedTestState
rule.message: All tests of this class share this field, and this test changes it, so a test passes or fails depending on the tests that ran before it. Shared fields are static ones, and every field of a class with @TestInstance(PER_CLASS) or of a TestNG class (one instance runs all its tests). Create the state in the test, or assign it (or clear() it) in @BeforeEach, @Before or @BeforeMethod so every test starts from the same value. State built once in @BeforeAll that the tests only read is fine.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $testMarks := ('Test', 'ParameterizedTest', 'RepeatedTest', 'TestFactory', 'TestTemplate'), $perTestMarks := ('BeforeEach', 'AfterEach', 'Before', 'After', 'BeforeMethod', 'AfterMethod'), $onceMarks := ('BeforeAll', 'AfterAll', 'BeforeClass', 'AfterClass', 'BeforeSuite', 'AfterSuite', 'BeforeTest', 'AfterTest', 'BeforeGroups', 'AfterGroups'), $mutators := '^(add|put|remove|clear|set|push|pop|offer|poll|compute|merge|replace|retain|sort|append|insert|delete|increment|decrement|getAnd|accumulate|update|lazySet|compareAndSet|drain)', $resetters := ('clear', 'set', 'reset', 'lazySet', 'setLength'), $marked := function($method, $marks) { $method/ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = $marks }, $mutableType := function($field) { exists($field/ArrayType) or exists($field/ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Map') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.StringBuilder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.StringBuffer') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicIntegerArray') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLongArray') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReferenceArray') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.atomic.DoubleAdder')]) }, $singleInstance := function($class) { exists($class/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'TestInstance'][.//*[@Name = 'PER_CLASS']]) or exists($class/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.testng.annotations.Test')]) or exists($class/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.testng.annotations.Test')]) }, $fieldOf := function($ref) { let $name := string($ref/@Name), $qualifier := $ref/self::FieldAccess/*[1], $member := $ref/ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer or self::LambdaExpression][last()] return if ($ref/self::FieldAccess and not($qualifier[self::ThisExpression or self::TypeExpression[ClassType/@SimpleName = $ref/ancestor::ClassDeclaration/@SimpleName]])) then () else if ($ref/self::VariableAccess and exists($member//VariableId[@Name = $name][@Field = false()])) then () else ($ref/ancestor::ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name = $name])[last()] }, $writes := ( //AssignmentExpression/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess], //UnaryExpression[@Operator = ('++', '--')]/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess], //ArrayAccess[@AccessType = 'WRITE']/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess], //MethodCall[matches(@MethodName, $mutators)]/*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]) return $writes [let $ref := ., $field := $fieldOf(.), $class := $field/../.., $direct := exists(parent::AssignmentExpression | parent::UnaryExpression) return exists($field) and not($field/ModifierList/Annotation) and (if ($direct) then not($field/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Final = true()) else if (parent::ArrayAccess) then exists($field/ArrayType) else $mutableType($field)) and ($field/@Static = true() or $singleInstance($class)) and exists($class//MethodDeclaration[$marked(., $testMarks)]) and (let $site := ancestor::MethodDeclaration[last()], $name := string($field/VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name), $hooks := $class//MethodDeclaration[$marked(., $perTestMarks)], $helpers := $class/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration [@Name = $hooks//MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]]/@MethodName], $resets := ($hooks | $helpers)//( AssignmentExpression[@Operator = '=']/*[1] | MethodCall[@MethodName = $resetters][ArgumentList/@Size le 1]/*[1]) [self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess][@Name = $name][$fieldOf(.) is $field], $callers := $class//MethodCall[@MethodName = $site/@Name][*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]], $onceOnly := exists($callers) and (every $call in $callers satisfies $marked($call/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[last()], $onceMarks)) return exists($site) and not($marked($site, $onceMarks)) and ($marked($site, ($testMarks, $perTestMarks)) or (exists($callers) and not($onceOnly))) and empty($resets))] /(parent::MethodCall | parent::AssignmentExpression | parent::UnaryExpression | parent::ArrayAccess/(parent::AssignmentExpression | parent::UnaryExpression))
